glyph_desc.fire: A bolt of fire down the lane. Put out by Water; burns walls twice as fast.
glyph_desc.water: A wave that puts out Fire and drowns the foe's ink. Ice turns it into a wall.
glyph_desc.wind: A whirlwind that sends back the spells it meets (except Earth).
glyph_desc.bolt: Strikes the whole lane after a moment. A Shield stops it dead; Water makes it stronger.
glyph_desc.earth: Slow, heavy spikes. Break Shields and Walls; Wind cannot turn them.
glyph_desc.shield: A golden circle that takes the blows for a few seconds.
glyph_desc.wall: A stone wall before you, in the lane where you draw it. It blocks everything.
glyph_desc.star: Three stars, one per lane: there is no dodging them all.
glyph_desc.ice: Freezes what it touches; hit, the foe’s ink flows slower.
glyph_desc.time: The foe’s spells slow to half speed, and your ink flows faster.
glyph_desc.seal: The next spell the foe casts within three seconds fizzles out.

campaign.title: THE APPRENTICE
campaign.sub: Ysolde, apprentice to Master Aldric, and the ink that got away.

1.name: The Lesson
1.desc: First day in the scriptorium. Aldric teaches you three glyphs, then puts you to the test — gently.

2.name: The Two Banks
2.desc: The ink has fled down the river. You hold both banks at once: what you draw on a bank comes alive there.

3.name: The Ash Witch
3.desc: She speaks only in flames. Learn Earth: fire cannot stop it.

4.name: The Misty Ford
4.desc: Mists, thorns and chasms. The ink creatures are multiplying.

5.name: The Tide Monk
5.desc: Waves and ice as far as the eye can see. Lightning runs through water: make use of it.

6.name: The Ink Forest
6.desc: No light under these trees. Stars to see, Healing to endure.

7.name: The Clockmaker
7.desc: He slows time and seals your spells. Learn the Hourglass, and do not cast blindly.

8.name: The Beast of the River
8.desc: At the end of the river, the Beast guards the Library. Its eye moves from bank to bank.

9.name: The Master's Trial
9.desc: Aldric no longer holds back. He wants to know if you are ready.

10.name: The Ink Queen
10.desc: She escaped from a forbidden book. She knows every glyph. So do you, now.

setup.duel_rules: Three lanes, two mages. Draw your glyphs, read your opponent’s, answer faster. Every glyph is open. Two players: mouse against gamepad.
setup.rives_rules: Two mages walk along the river. Alone, you hold both banks; with two (mouse + gamepad), each guards the other’s bank.

results.duel_lost: Your opponent read your glyphs before you did.
results.rives_won: Both mages reached the end of the road.

online.title: ONLINE
online.rules: For two, at a distance: a duel, or an expedition on the Two Banks. The host chooses.

ending.credits: GRIMOIRE — design, code, music: a one-person studio and its quill. Thanks for playing.

1: Ah, there you are. Put that book down, Ysolde: today we do not write words. We write the world.
A glyph is a shape the ink recognises. Draw it well, and it obeys. Draw it large, and it obeys hard.
And if I draw it badly?
It laughs at you, and so does your opponent. Come: Fire, Water, Shield. Then a little duel with your old master.
2: Ysolde! The forbidden book, on the back lectern… it is open. And empty.
The ink ran down to the river. It is on both banks!
I take the night bank, you the day bank. But you will draw: what you draw on a bank comes alive there. Wall makes a bridge, Wind clears the mist.
3: An apprentice? Aldric sends me an apprentice? I will send her back to her master as a little pile of ash.
She has the Queen’s black ink on her hands, Ysolde. She serves the enemy without knowing it. Learn Earth: her flames can do nothing against it.
4: The Witch told me where the ink hides: further down, at the ford. There are creatures everywhere.
Then freeze them. Ice stops what runs — and what swims.
5: The sea erases everything, little one. Footprints in the sand, names on graves… and badly drawn glyphs.
Lightning, Ysolde. It strikes the whole lane at once, and water carries it further still.
6: The ink forest. Not a single ray of light. You will need Stars to see, and Healing to last to the end.
I am old, that is all. Walk on.
7: Tick. You are three seconds late for everything. Tock. I am going to take them from you.
He seals spells cast without thinking. Watch his glyphs form before you answer. And take his Hourglass.
8: The drowned Library lies at the end of the river. The Beast guards it. Its eye moves from bank to bank: strike where it looks.
And the Seal, at last. The last glyph I can teach you. It dispels what is about to strike.
9: Before you enter the Library, I must know. No lesson this time. Every glyph. I will hold nothing back.
Then I will have been a good teacher.
10: Little scribe. You think the glyphs belong to you? They are made of ink. And the ink is me.
The glyphs belong to whoever draws them.
Then draw. Draw until your hand shakes.

intro.text: At the top of the cliff, Aldric’s scriptorium tower. Here, one does not write books: one writes the world.
For the golden ink obeys whoever can draw it. A flame, a wave, a spiral of wind: each glyph is a spell.
But at the back of the library sleeps a book no one must open. Its ink never sleeps.

finale.text: The Ink Queen unravels into a thousand letters, falling onto the pages like black rain.
Ysolde gathers them one by one, and closes the book. On the cover, a new glyph: her own.
That evening, Master Aldric hands her the key to the scriptorium. “What you draw, the world writes. Never forget to draw well.”
